exam.title: Statistics I - Exam B
exam.subtitle: Descriptive statistics, distributions and tests
exam.instructions: Complete all tasks thoroughly. Show your work. Permitted aids: non-programmable calculator, standard normal and t-distribution tables.

exercises.title: Mean, Median, Variance
exercises.description:
Given the data: 10, 12, 13, 15, 15, 16, 18, 21.

a) Compute the mean.
b) Determine the median.
c) Compute the sample variance and standard deviation.
solutionSteps:
Step 2: Median
Sorted data: 10, 12, 13, 15, 15, 16, 18, 21
Median = average of the 4th and 5th values = (15+15)/2 = 15

Step 3: Sample variance
Deviations from 15: -5, -3, -2, 0, 0, 1, 3, 6
Squares: 25, 9, 4, 0, 0, 1, 9, 36
Sum of squares = 84
$s^2 = \frac{1}{n-1}\sum (x_i-\bar{x})^2 = 84/7 = 12$

exercises.title: Binomial and Poisson Approximation
exercises.description:
A device has failure probability $p=0.02$. In a batch of $n=100$ devices:

a) Compute $P(X=3)$ for $X \sim B(100;0.02)$.
b) Approximate this probability with a Poisson distribution.
c) Compute the probability that at least one device fails.

exercises.title: Standardization and Quantiles
exercises.description:
Product lifetime is normally distributed with $\mu=100$ and $\sigma=15$.

a) Compute $P(90 \le X \le 120)$.
b) Determine the 90% quantile.

exercises.title: Confidence Interval for a Proportion
exercises.description:
In a sample of $n=200$ observations, 36 successes were recorded.
Find a 95% confidence interval for the true proportion $p$.

exercises.title: z-Test for the Mean
exercises.description:
A manufacturer claims the mean is $\mu=50$. The standard deviation is known: $\sigma=6$.
A sample of $n=25$ yields $\bar{x}=52$.
Perform a two-sided test at the 5% level.
solutionSteps:
Step 3: Decision
Critical region: $|z|>1.96$
Since $1.667<1.96$, fail to reject $H_0$.
